$comment: Vulnerability triage decisions for release/sbom (the maintainers' vulnerability-response runbook §3). First matching rule wins. Statuses: affected (fix under the SLA), fix-planned, not-affected (VEX-style justification), false-positive (the scanner matched the wrong software or version), not-shipped (build/test-only dependency), under-investigation (a decision is still owed; owner named), accepted-risk (named owner and expiry). Evidence for 2026-09-25 decisions: govulncheck symbol-level traces, `gradle dependencyInsight`, `pnpm why`, `nix why-depends` on the pinned closure — see docs/release/sbom.md “Triage notes”. No code was changed by this triage.

rules.justification: build/test-only dependency (pnpm scope excluded); in no shipped artifact. Bump with the next routine dependency update.

golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm (Span/Properties/Transform) is linked into whombat-backup per govulncheck -mode binary; an infinite loop on invalid input is a local DoS of the backup service if attacker-influenced strings (file names in workspaces) reach it. Fix: bump golang.org/x/text to >= v0.39.0 in the appliance go.mod, rebuild, rescan. Class 2 (host) update.
rules.owner: appliance (W3-BK) — fix in the next appliance release

rules.justification: library module graph (go.mod requires x/text v0.14.0); consumers select their own version by MVS: relay links v0.40.0 (fixed), the appliance links v0.36.0 (tracked under the appliance rows). Raise the contracts go.mod floor to v0.39.0 in the next contracts release so consumers can't select a vulnerable version.
x/text v0.36.0 is linked but govulncheck finds no vulnerable symbol in this binary; bumped together with whombat-backup (>= v0.39.0).

vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path: every advisory is in x/crypto/ssh, ssh/agent, ssh/knownhosts or openpgp, and govulncheck -mode binary finds none of their symbols in the manager, helper, recovery manager or tufrepo (the appliance has no SSH server or agent, NX-10). Bump x/crypto to >= v0.56.0 with the x/text bump anyway so future scans stay quiet.

uuid@7.0.3 is reached only via xcode@3.0.1 ← @expo/config-plugins (pnpm why): prebuild-time native-project tooling, not bundled by Metro into the app, and the flaw needs caller-supplied buffers for v3/v5/v6. Expo upgrade will drop it.

commons-io 2.6 enters the release APK via expo-document-picker (gradle dependencyInsight). Inputs are documents the user picked on the phone, not remote data; whether FilenameUtils.normalize/XmlStreamReader are called on them needs a code read of expo-document-picker 57.0.2. Upstream (Expo) fix or a Gradle constraint to commons-io >= 2.14.0.

gson 2.8.6 enters the release APK via expo-log-box (dependencyInsight): the developer error overlay, fed by the local bundler, not remote input. Confirm it is inert in release builds or constrain gson >= 2.8.9.
these CVEs are for the Jenkins Git plugin, not git; vulnix matched the CPE product name 'git'.
vulnix parsed version '1' from the generated 'dbus-1' configuration directory; the closure's dbus is 1.16.2, later than the fixed releases of CVE-2022-42010/42011/42012.
the advisory concerns -fstack-protector code generation on AArch64 only; this closure is x86_64 (the aarch64 image is evaluated, not built or shipped, NX-15). gcc appears only as the libgcc runtime.
historic distribution-specific advisories (not upstream OpenSSH 10.5p1); matched by CPE product only.

no sshd unit exists in the closure (NX-10: no remote login); OpenSSH is present as the ssh client (git over SSH). Server-side advisories are not reachable; client-side ones need a per-CVE check. Resolve by the nixpkgs 26.05 bump + rescan.

binutils is in the closure only through lanzaboote's lzbt (nix why-depends), which runs objcopy on locally built, trusted UKI inputs at install time; no untrusted object files are processed on the host. Sandboxed task code that brings its own binutils is untrusted by design (T6).
no unbound daemon runs (no unit); libunbound is linked by gnutls for DANE. Most advisories are resolver-side. Resolve by the nixpkgs 26.05 bump + rescan; vulnix ignores nixpkgs patches.

upstream package in the pinned nixpkgs nixos-26.05 (c508844, 2026-09-24). vulnix/grype match versions and ignore patches nixpkgs applies. Action: bump the nixos-26.05 pin (a class 2 update), rescan, and check the remaining CVE against the package's patches and whether a Whombat service exposes the code (appliance has no inbound listeners, T9).
